notes.title: Development Update 2025-05-31
notes.content:
We've hit the point where we'll be running our first external playtesting sessions. There's enough game in place to get feedback on how to go from here. We're still a ways off from public playtesting.

For the development status, here's some quick notes on what each section needs to move forward.

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
Much of what remains here is tweaking, polishing, and of course the missing scenes.
[list][*]Replace remaining placeholders[/*][*]Story elements (the generic parts and holders)[/*][*]Settings screen[/*][/list][h3]Audio[/h3]
We've just started here, so basically everything needs to be done.
[h3]Engine[/h3][list][*]Load management and feedback[/*][*]Audio ambience[/*][*]Controller support[/*][*]Keyboard support[/*][*]Render optimization[/*][*]Mid-run save and reload[/*][*]Achievements[/*][/list][h3]Animation[/h3]
Animations make the game feel alive (and hide loading).
[list][*]Scene transitions[/*][*]Object animations, like tubes, chip activations, counters, etc.[/*][*]Idle animations[/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*]Many more tubes[/*][*]More vendor options[/*][*]More chip purchase options[/*][*]End of run[/*][/list][h3]Progression[/h3]
Not everything should available at once, to avoid overwhelming new players and to give a sense of progression.
[list][*]Task/event based gating of tubes[/*][*]Step-wise reveal of fiddle sticks[/*][*]Map staging[/*][/list][h3]Modes[/h3]
Beyond the basic gameplay, we'd like to add special challenge modes. These might come quite late in the development, possibly not until early access.
[list][*]Machine selection (upgrades stored per machine)[/*][/list][h3]Story[/h3]
Rabanaz is a steam punk casino and there's a purpose to you hacking their machines. It won't have a significant impact on gameplay but to add flavour.
[list][*]Cut-scene panels[/*][*]Vendor panels[/*][*]Bad Tube characters[/*][*]End-Run[/*][*]End-Game[/*][/list]
